## Summary

Explain what changed and why it belongs in the Enterprise AI Framework.

## Change type

- [ ] Editorial correction
- [ ] Architecture or blueprint
- [ ] Governance, security, privacy, or risk guidance
- [ ] Compliance mapping
- [ ] Release or repository infrastructure
- [ ] Breaking or normative change

## Evidence and decisions

Link issues, authoritative sources, architecture decisions, and source versions. Identify interpretation or opinion explicitly.

## Impact

Describe affected audiences, compatibility, migration, security, privacy, accessibility, regulatory, and operational implications.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `mkdocs build --strict` successfully.
- [ ] Markdown and links pass automated checks.
- [ ] New or changed diagrams include accessible text and editable sources.
- [ ] Compliance mappings avoid certification claims and identify source versions.
- [ ] I disclosed material affiliations or vendor interests.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` for a notable change.
- [ ] My commits include a DCO `Signed-off-by` line.

## Reviewer guidance

Identify the domain expertise required and any decisions that need particular attention.
